pages.title: Spirit Stones
pages.text: Spirit stones are condensed spiritual power. Mining spirit ore yields low-grade stones, whose power can support cultivation, breakthroughs, and talisman use.
Spirit stones are also used in charm, talisman, and pill recipes. With JEI installed, available crafting recipes are displayed automatically.

pages.title: Five-Element Spirit Stones
pages.text: Metal, wood, water, fire, and earth spirit stones each come in low, middle, high, and supreme grades. A held stone grants its bonus only when its element matches the player's spiritual-root attribute; neutral stones still support basic spiritual power absorption.
